messages:
Rae (PM): Sync: defining 'handshake presets' for private deploys to make upgrades predictable. Proposal: minimal, managed-relay, full-peer. Minimal = no host-network changes. Managed-relay = keep NAT, relay traffic. Full-peer = peering + host route edits (netops sign-off).

Ish (eng): Agree. CLI flags: --preset=minimal|relay|peer and --dry-run that emits a plan + sha256. Dry-run should list host edits and required ports.

Maya (field): Field wants: preflight artifacts we can send to customers (signed bundle + checksum), and a UI approval flow for peer installs. Also airgap support for dry-run output.

Jun (netops): Netops requirements: deterministic egress IPs for audits, firewall rules per preset, and a sign-off checklist (ASN, expected next-hops). Bridge/peer must not change BGP attributes without approval.

Ish (eng): Implementation sketch: operator runs net-check job in dry-run; outputs preflight.json with PASS/WARN/FAIL and suggested fixes. Preflight stored in assets with checksum.

ci-bot: ci-bot: nightly preflight-run queued for pilot-org-2

Rae (PM): Launch gates suggestion: 3 pilot customers pass preflight, canary cohort of 5 installs with 60m observation, rollback <10m for 95% installs, and signed-bundle support for airgap.

Maya (field): Action items: I can collect pilot candidates. Also want a one-page quick-run for field engineers.

Jun (netops): I'll draft firewall matrix + egress-preserve behavior doc. Keep preserve default=false and explicit flag.

Ish (eng): I'll add dry-run + plan sha to installer (ETA 5d) and a simple "installer revert --to-sha=<sha>" command.

Rae (PM): Great. I'll author the WIP in /docs/private/handshake-presets.md and pull in security for review. Keep defaults conservative.
